description: Full details for one CielStay listing: description, photos, amenities, house rules, location, and every booking link CielStay holds, including the host's own booking site. With checkIn and checkOut, the response also carries liveQuote where the host's booking engine supports it: the total on the host's own site for those dates (room, fees and taxes), read live. Each live quote is a real request to the host's booking engine. Accepts the listing id, the slug from a listing URL, or a short code (the "1zwf" in cielstay.com/l/1zwf).

checkIn.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. With checkOut, returns the live total from the host's own booking site.

guests.description: Number of guests, for the live quote. Defaults to 2.

id.description: The listing ID from a previous search result (result.id).

name: get_listing_details

liveQuote.description: The total on the host's own site for the dates asked, read live; null when it couldn't be read

basis.description: What the figure is: e.g. avg_night_incl_fees, avg_nightly_rate_excl_fees, host_set, monthly_rent

label.description: The qualifier to show next to the price

title: Get listing details
